# instance-registry

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from plugins/instance-registry-datasource/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/instance-registry.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `instance-registry` component of `plugins/instance-registry-datasource`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry`: generated from its catalogue, [instance-registry.json](../../plugins/instance-registry-datasource/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/instance-registry.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `INSTANCE_REGISTRY` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `JDBC URL` (plugin field) | Unset; a secret, never shown | Development only: the JDBC URL of the Identity Object Model database holding the agent instance registry, the same one device-enrolment's IDM_DATABASE_URL names, credentials included, used when no PingFederate data store is chosen; under the production profile the driver refuses it at configure and answers every lookup with the refusal, naming "PingFederate data store" to use instead (plan item PR-3) (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry") | **Per request**: Set under the production profile: every lookup fails, naming the field to use instead, and the issuance is refused. Wrong or unreachable: every lookup fails and the issuance is refused. Another database: every lookup resolves to an unknown instance | Not in production: any value | Yes |
| `User verification max age (seconds)` (plugin field) | `300`; seconds | How recent the owner's user verification must be for uv_fresh to be true; it must match the enrolment service's UV_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, or the two disagree about when an agent stops (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry") | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the driver configures nothing and every lookup fails, naming the field (before 0.6.0 it fell back to 300) | Any | Yes |
| `instance_id` (plugin field) | Unset | The data source's filter field: an access token mapping supplies the attestation's agent_id here (instance_id=${agent_id}) (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry") | **Per request**: Mapped to anything but the agent_id: every lookup resolves to an unknown instance, and a criterion on instance_active refuses the token | Any | Yes |
| `PingFederate data store` (plugin field) | Unset | The production way to the registry: a PingFederate JDBC data store on the Identity Object Model database (the same one device-enrolment's IDM_DATABASE_URL names), chosen from PingFederate's own list; its value is the data store's JNDI name, which PingFederate sets to the data store's id, and its connections come from PingFederate's pool with PingFederate's credentials. It wins over the JDBC URL (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry") | **Per request**: Unset with no JDBC URL: every lookup fails, naming it. A data store whose database is not PostgreSQL: refused under the production profile at the first lookup (INSTANCE_REGISTRY), a warning under development. Unreachable: every lookup fails and the issuance is refused | Any | Yes |
